items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Then we divorced. Both of us got married again. But we were the best of friends and we still go to the same church.

ctx.x: Did your other friends have costumes, too? Would you hang around with other people? No, no, no. Would you go out on the parade route with your costume on?

Yeah. But I wouldn't go out by myself. My mother would be with me. She wouldn't let us out of our sight on Mardi Grotti. And a lot of times, a lot of places I went to, when it was Mardi Grotti, I never would've gone there without my trumpet. Now like when I had my little girlfriend and I wanted to see her, I would lie and tell my mother I had a job to play. Take my trumpet out. What? My childhood sweetheart. What was her name? Gene. Gene Hitchens. Gene Hitchens. And when I was in the Navy, I came home on leave…
So Gene wasn't like that? She wanted to have her own life?
